prose: The original Susquehanna Sage, Mike Wann, returns to InnerVerse! Last month I was blessed with an in-person visit with the uniquely mystical man himself, as part of his coast-to-coast magical summer roadtrip. As we've come to expect from Mike, his journey is riddled with, well, riddles, as the events in the media and his own divergent discoveries meshed together in a fractal expression of the great cosmic script of consciousness. In this episode, the master story-teller will unpack some of the mysteries he uncovered on his path from Pennsylvania to California and back.
music: Featured music, "It's Both" by Wisdom Traders
